name: POST /api/dialer/calling-window/check - May this recipient be called now (recipient-local calling window)
description: Returns the calling_window gate's own verdict for a recipient (0892cb5b-f0d4-43a5-b3db-770361137b1b#AC4 — the calling-window check uses the recipient's local time zone). The window is the campaign's window_start-window_end when campaign_id is given, else DIALER_DEFAULT_WINDOW 08:00-21:00, evaluated in the RECIPIENT's local time: recipient_timezone when given; else the campaign's default_timezone; else STRICTLY in every time zone of the number's country (a US number with no timezone is callable only when it is inside the window from New York to Honolulu); else DIALER_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE. It is computed with sdk-notification's quiet-hours engine (the window's complement is the recipient's quiet hours on every weekday), so DST and half-hour offsets follow the tz database. Response: allowed, reason (inside_calling_window | outside_calling_window | calling_window_unreachable), window_start, window_end, timezones, timezone_source (recipient | country:<CC> | default), local_times per zone, closed_timezones, and next_open_at — the first instant the window is open in every zone (null when allowed now, or when the zones never share the window within 8 days). at (ISO-8601, default now) evaluates another instant. The same function drives the gate, so an outbound call dispatched outside the window is deferred to next_open_at. Edge cases: to_number must be E.164 (400); recipient_timezone must be an IANA zone (400); campaign_id must be a uuid (400) of this tenant (404); tenant_id, when given, must be the authenticated tenant (403).
